activity_summary: You gave Susanna the fables with woodcuts and no riddles, Judith the ballad, and Hamnet the chipped H. You sang the ballad once, badly, and Judith had the tune and the words. You yielded on whom. You told Susanna the queen steps into the shadow of the trees, and that she had had it right. Anne asked three weeks. You said till the eighteenth. She said hm.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the three, sang once, and yielded on whom.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the fables, corrected whom, and asked about the queen.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the ballad at one hearing.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the H, and asked who Plutarch is.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked the three weeks, heard the eighteenth, and went on.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Named as the man who will say Plutarch is dear. Not in the orchard.

facets.activity: Gave the fables, the ballad and the chipped H, and said till the eighteenth
